I found no blocking issues, and nothing decided this round or earlier is removed or weakened. I read the whole diff e5356d4..HEAD against decisions7.md, the triage and the earlier decisions. All 48 lines in scope are in the code as decisions7 and the triage describe them. 60.20 is only ticked and 45.16 is left out, as decided.

Round 6's decisions still hold:
- **Illumination ring and held marks:** untouched.
- **Roll replay:** still replays a roll the server holds open. Only End Assignment now drops the replayable rolls, and a held gilded roll is kept, settled.

**Server checks:**
- **69.3 (milestones_earned):** correct for new circles, for circles from before the column (they count the milestones their track already stands past) and across the advance. A small simulation agreed.
- **69.7, 45.2, 45.3/45.13, 60.13, 60.7 and 45.10:** do what is claimed. The roll and log text still parse through rulebookLogText.
- **Docs and tests:** test_00_startup, test_surface, WEBSOCKET.md and QUIRKS.md are updated.
- **Test run:** targeted tests passed on a throwaway database: 796 passed across test_00_startup, test_ws_circle, test_ws_rolls, test_ws_timer, test_surface and test_access. vite build passes.

**Browser checks** (Chromium, own throwaway database, servers stopped by PID, databases dropped):
- The Chapter House box no longer crashes, and it says "Not saved yet" then "Saved".
- Player desk at 1366x768: "Proposed" stamp, "1 scar" on the self card, the skip link landing on Actions, and "1 Nerve spent" after a roll.
- Lightkeeper desk at 1440x900, sheet open: the strip's + raises the tension.
- The End stamp keeps its place when armed (y 588 to 591).
- End Assignment clears and hides the timer and the switch shows off.
- The player's tray empties live and stays empty after a reload. The held gilded case is covered by the new test.

**Seams between groups:**
- The dice group's gameStore works with the sheet group's spent cue: rollError is cleared on send and set on a refusal, and the End Assignment branch resets it.
- It also works with the refused-question fix: abilityUsed is untouched.
- The skip link renders only on the player's own sheet (the Lightkeeper's copy is readOnly), so it never meets the sticky stamps. The new desk header did not change its tab order.

**Two "should" issues:**
- **69.3 edge case:** a milestone passed while every resource is full is still recorded as counted. So if the Lightkeeper corrects that point back down, the later real hit earns nothing, which e5356d4 got right. Simulated: 2 to 3 while full, back to 2, a Stitch spent, then 2 to 3 gives 0.
- **60.18 status line:** it says "Not saved yet" when another member changed the chapter house after this desk saved.

**Choices Robert may not expect.** These fit the decisions:
- Desk: "Ada (1 relationship)" wording. The milestone named only in the Resource Management line, plus "the rest have nowhere to go". The floating armed hint (checked steady). The read-only strip on phones. Insignia check order. ArmedDetail for Reset. A withdrawn request's sheet kept for any removal not answered at this desk, cleared again on re-request.
- Sheet: the restored edit draft is held without a store change. Dropping aria-pressed goes against the triage, but decision 1 allows it and it is the better ARIA. The cue sits under the drive title. The sticky gear footer. The empty-gear line shows on the player's own sheet only.
- Dice: the Locked InfoTerm. The "Let in: press Play" stamp under the name. The "i" on the waiting heading. Sign-up heading unchanged (no such heading on that screen). Hollow dot for a burn. Recipient kept with a loud Private tag. Replayed rolls never steal focus.

Choices to flag rather than accept outright:
- **Finalize confirm (69.4):** with three or more empty parts it says "leaving N parts empty" without naming them. It still keeps both losses in one sentence, as decision 2 asks.
- **60.16 skip link:** it is the 3rd Tab stop on a phone and the 6th on a tablet or laptop, not the first.
- **45.10:** the roll names every ability the player toggled, including one that changed nothing on that roll.
- **60.18:** "Not saved yet" when someone else edited the chapter house does not fit (one of the two "should" issues).

44px touch targets, help on demand, one-sentence confirms with one-verb buttons and "Lightkeeper" (never "GM") hold in every added line. No AI model names appear in any file (only the required commit trailers).

The only em dashes in added lines are the existing log-format dash, kept in the two modified roll log lines. The client parser and the tests depend on it.

issues.problem: A milestone is raised into milestones_earned even when cap_earn_backs turns its earn-back into nothing (every resource full), and a later fall does not lower it, since nothing waits. Scenario: Illumination 2 to 3 by mistake with all resources full, corrected 3 to 2, then a Stitch is spent and the real milestone is hit (2 to 3): earn_backs stays 0. e5356d4 gave 1 here, and the FAQ says a correction past a milestone undoes it. B is the same: a waiting earn-back capped away by a manual refill keeps its milestone counted. Simulated with _count_earn_backs.
issues.fix: Count only the milestones that actually produced an earn-back. After cap_earn_backs, set milestones_earned to counted[granted-1] when granted > 0, else leave it as it was. Alternatively, in the fall loop also lower milestones_earned past a milestone that got nothing. Add a test for full, then rise, fall, spend, rise. This is Robert's call if he prefers the stricter reading.

issues.problem: After this desk saves, if another member changes the shared chapter house, the line reads 'Not saved yet', though nothing of this desk's is unsaved. The status claims something false (implementer choice 5).
issues.fix: Show 'Not saved yet' only while houseDraft differs, or when the send failed (houseSent.ok false). Show nothing, rather than 'Not saved yet', once the stored text differs from what this desk sent.

issues.problem: End Assignment now clears and hides the countdown (decision 5), but the 'What ending does' i, the receipt, the log line and FAQ.md never say so. A Lightkeeper with a timer running loses it silently.
issues.fix: Add 'The timer is cleared.' to ENDS (the i and the receipt), and add a clause to the FAQ's End Assignment text.

issues.problem: FAQ:240 still says the server fires a milestone notification at every multiple of 3; a circle without Resource Management now logs none. New test test_a_milestone_passed_with_every_resource_full_is_not_counted in test_ws_circle.py; the legacy test now seeds milestones_earned=6; test_00_startup checks that the migration sets an existing circle at 7 to 6.
